public_protocol_fields.inclusion_criteria:
1. Body weight of 10kg or more
  2. Dogs with stage II-V B cell lymphoma
  3. Dogs who have not responded to chemotherapy OR who have relapsed following chemotherapy OR dogs who’s owners have opted not to treat with chemotherapy
  4. Dogs who have been off chemotherapy for at least 3 weeks
  5. Adequate blood, liver, and kidney function
  6. No significant co-morbidities
  7. Expected survival time of at least 2 months at the time of enrollment
public_protocol_fields.intervention_name: Genetically engineered immune cells known as chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cells armed with a growth protein, IL-18.

public_protocol_fields.name: Cellular immunotherapy for the treatment of B cell lymphoma or leukemia

raw_metadata_policy: Only public protocol identity/status/date fields retained; unrelated script configuration excluded.
